**Finding: deviation (medium)** — Section 12, ¶p0086.

**What's compliant:** The software conformance warranty runs for the acceptance period plus one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date (and continues while the Software is under Maintenance Services), which meets the preferred 12-month software position. Importantly, there is no "AS IS" clause and no disclaimer of implied warranties anywhere in the Agreement, so nothing swallows the express warranty.

**What's deficient:**
- **No warranty remedy.** Section 12 states the warranty but prescribes no consequence for breach. The nearest substitutes are inadequate: Sections 7–8 give a rejection/refund right only during the acceptance period and expressly "in lieu of any other remedy," and Section 10(c) Software Repair Service is a "best efforts" obligation contingent on a paid maintenance subscription.
- **No services warranty.** Installation, data conversion, training and Maintenance Services carry no professional/workmanlike standard.
- **No compliance-with-laws or no-malicious-code warranty.**

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** a single new paragraph inserted after ¶p0086 adding (a) a professional and workmanlike standard plus 90-day services conformance warranty, (b) compliance with laws, (c) no malicious code, and a repair/replace/re-perform remedy escalating to a refund if not cured within 30 days of notice. The existing 12-month software warranty is left untouched, so this is purely additive.
